help.name: The exam name, e.g. Half Yearly 2026. Two exams of the same class and year cannot share a name.
help.kind: Term, monthly, model or other. Cannot change once results are published.
help.deadline: Teachers see the days left on their dashboard. Leave empty if there is none.
help.academicYear: The year the exam belongs to. Chosen only when you add the exam.
help.class: The class that sits the exam. Pick the year first; it cannot change later.
help.template: Pick an exam structure and the parts for the class subjects are made for you. Hidden when there is no structure.
help.componentName: The part name, e.g. Written. Two parts of one subject cannot share a name.
help.componentKind: Written, MCQ, viva, practical and so on. Attendance is counted for you.
help.fullMarks: The full marks of the part, e.g. 70; a positive number. Not shown for an attendance part.
help.passMarks: The pass mark of the part, e.g. 23. Not more than the full marks. Leave empty if not needed.
help.exam: The exam you are entering marks for. Its marks lists for the sections and subjects you may enter show below.
help.mark: The marks for that student and part, up to the maximum shown. Type A for absent and E for exempt. Attendance parts are worked out for you.
help.byPart: On the Pass/fail tab, tick it to see the results for each part of a subject, not only for the whole subject.

finalResults.share: How much of the final result each exam counts for. They must add up to 100, e.g. Half Yearly 30, Annual 70.
finalResults.rounding: How a subject total is rounded. "To a whole number" turns 83.7 into 84.
finalResults.failIfAnyExamFails: When on, failing even one counted exam fails that subject, however high the total. When off, only the total decides.
finalResults.perSubjectShare: Turn on if subjects should not all use the same shares. For example Maths 40 and 60, English 30 and 70.
finalResults.bestOf: Only the student's best few exams count in each subject. For example the best 2 of 3 exams.

helpRequired.name: Yes
